results.title: Jumpskip for Netflix: Watch movies on Netflix without the jumpscares | Product Hunt
results.content:
Title: Jumpskip for Netflix: Watch movies on Netflix without the jumpscares | Product Hunt
# Jumpskip for Netflix. ## Watch movies on Netflix without the jumpscares. Jumpskip is a Chrome Extension for Netflix that helps you watch movies without being scared by jumpscares. Skip, mute, get a warning when jumpscares are about to happen, view all the jumpscare timestamps, and much more. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Jumpskip for Netflix. I love horror movies, but I absolutely cannot stand jumpscares 😓 In the past I had to skip over classics such as Alien or The Thing because of them. That gave me the idea to build a tool that could skip, mute, or warn you when a jumpscare is about to happen, using data from wheresthejump.com. **Here are some of its features:** ⏭️ Automatically skip jumpscares 🔇 Automatically mute jumpscares ⚠️ Show a warning when a jumpscare is about to happen 👻 See how many jumpscares a movie has in detail 🕒 Customize the in/out times for skips and warnings 🎚️ See whether the jumpscare is minor or major 🍿 Quick access to Netflix ⏯️ Play and pause movies through the extension The code is available on GitHub if you'd like to contribute to Jumpskip, self-host it, or build your own trigger warning extension. Finally now I can make my partner to watch all kinds of movies. Super cool but the guys will miss the part where the girl getting scared hides and hold you tight ahahah. Wow, I thought that for horror fans, screemers were the most interesting thing in movies. I, for example, don't like horror movies and if I understand that there are a lot of screamers in a show, I won't watch it. HBO used to have great series of all kinds of genres, but now there's nothing at all. So I canceled my subscription and bought a netflix account at  They are developing very well now, there are a lot of new projects and there is always something interesting. I just wanted to ask what tool you used to make the preview video for the extension? I hate horror movies because of jumpscares, not sure if you can help me with that but i will give it a try :).

Title: Netflix AutoSkip: Stream Smarter, Skip Faster | Product Hunt
# Netflix AutoSkip. ## Stream Smarter, Skip Faster. ## Stream Smarter, Skip Faster. Automatically skip intros, recaps, 'Are you still watching?' and next episode on Netflix. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Netflix AutoSkip. Diffio AI — Audio Restoration — Never lose a great take to bad audio again. Never lose a great take to bad audio again. I’m excited to introduce Netflix AutoSkip, a tool designed to enhance your streaming experience. Learn More - https://netflix-autoskip.vercel.... Are you tired of constantly clicking "Skip Intro" or waiting for the next episode to start? Netflix AutoSkip automates these tasks, so you can dive straight into your binge-watching session with a simple toggle. ✨ Key Features: Automatic Intro Skipping: Seamlessly bypass intros and jump straight into the action. Seamless Transitions: Enjoy automatic episode skipping for uninterrupted viewing. 🔧 How It Works: Install AutoSkip from the Chrome Web Store. Enjoy a smoother, uninterrupted streaming experience. 🎉 Perfect For: Binge-Watchers: Keep the flow going without interruptions. Multitaskers: Let AutoSkip handle the skips while you focus on other tasks. 🚀 Get Started: Install AutoSkip today and elevate your streaming sessions! ❗Disclaimer: AutoSkip is an independent tool and is not affiliated with any third-party companies. Netflix AutoSkip is such a genius idea. This is amazing, I was wondering why this is not already a buit in feature on Netflix. We’re glad you’re enjoying Netflix AutoSkip. This is amazing, always wanted to skip the long recaps especially in ATLA haha. 🎉 We’re thrilled that Netflix AutoSkip is making your viewing experience better, especially with those long recaps in ATLA. Enjoy your uninterrupted binge-watching, and thanks for the support! How do you integrate it with Netflix? 🎉 Integrating Netflix AutoSkip is simple. Just install the Chrome extension (https://chromewebstore.google.co...), choose what would you like to skip, and it will automatically detect when intros, recaps, or end credits appear during your Netflix sessions. With one click, you're ready to enjoy uninterrupted binge-watching! 🙌 Netflix AutoSkip is a binge-watcher’s dream come true. @kyrylosilin Hi Kryrylo, Netflix AutoSkip currently works on Netflix streamed on Chrome/Chromium based browsers and FireFox. You can try it out yourself at - https://chromewebstore.google.co... or check out the website at - https://netflix-autoskip.vercel.....
